eyebrow: A sales order is a chain of references
code:
Order line
  -> Customer site  -> must have an active price list
  -> Item            -> must be enabled at the ship-from org
  -> Transaction type -> must point to an enabled source

Any missing link = order won't save, price, or invoice.
caption: Most "stuck order" tickets trace to one broken link in this chain.
